Contents.Contents:
Welcome!

Welcome to the Website Development course!

We would learn about the basics of creating websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

The goal of this course is to be able to build practical and functional web systems.

What Will We Build?

Throughout this course, we will learn the fundamentals needed to create systems such as:

Login / Sign-In System

We will learn how to create interfaces where users can log in and sign in.

CRUD / POS System

We will also learn how to build a CRUD and POS system for managing information and transactions.

What We Will Learn

We will learn how HTML creates the structure of a website, how CSS controls its appearance, and how JavaScript adds functionality and interaction.

By combining these three technologies, we can create complete and useful web applications.
